The file sits in src/models/** (domain) and holds a portfolio X-ray business rule: it works out a fee ratio and checks it against a configurable maximum threshold. That is domain logic. The file has no persistence, transport, HTTP or framework code. It does not touch a database or an external API.

The localized evaluation text is built by calling an injected I18nService. Formatting the percentages for that text is a small part of the job. getConfiguration() returns threshold metadata (min, max, step and unit) that describes the rule's own parameters. getSettings() resolves the rule's settings from user preferences, with defaults. All of these are part of the rule's definition, inherited from the Rule base class. None of them belongs to another layer kind.

The domain depending on application services (ExchangeRateDataService and I18nService) is an import-direction concern, which is out of scope here. Building localized messages inside the domain is a borderline presentation concern. It is delegated to a service rather than done in the file, so I do not count it as a misplaced responsibility.
